svg.title: A Gaussian-kernel SVM separating two rings
svg.desc: A disc of positive points surrounded by a ring of negative points. A closed curve, the SVM's decision boundary, runs between them, with dashed curves on either side where the decision function equals plus and minus one. The circled points, the support vectors, are the ones on or inside those dashed curves.
svg.text: f(x) = Σᵢ αᵢ y⁽ⁱ⁾ K(x⁽ⁱ⁾, x) + b
